Cover, each with options + a recommendation + cost in days + risk:
1. Data model of a built piece = a closed mesh (template, edited, or imported) + material + transform + scale; volume V from the mesh (signed tetra sum), V scales with s³; one piece may be several solids (union / combine). How BuiltPiece / Pieces / PieceBreaker / Rod / Timber would hold an ARBITRARY mesh instead of boxes / rods / logs, and what breaks (breaking an arbitrary mesh: plane splits as stone does? CSG? the native CSG crash of feel-1 L1 / feel-2 item 14 — check its status in .orchestra/tasks/62/feel2/stone/notes.md).

The editor in first person: place a template (wall, post, beam, floor, roof, arch…), grab handles to resize along axes, move / rotate / scale gizmo, snapping, combine and subtract; ghost preview with the live V m³ and «хватает / не хватает» of the material; where the volume is taken from (logs and boulders within reach / in the bag / a stockpile) and what is left (the remainder stays as a smaller log / stone piece, exact by the ledger). World actions over menus (design lessons). Keep it playable in the browser.

5. Perf in WebGL2: draw calls (the polygon tour gate is 300), triangles, LOD / simplification of imported meshes, physics bodies count.
